data.description: Causes uncontrollable sneezing for 1d4+1 rounds. Anyone standing in the square of impact must succeed at a DC 12 Fortitude save to resist the powder, while those in adjacent squares must make DC 8 Fortitude saves. Affected creatures must make a DC 10 Fortitude save every round for the duration or be staggered until their next turn.
